title: Assemblies, attributes, reflection — quick overview
rememberThis: internal is assembly-wide; InternalsVisibleTo names a friend by simple name (and public key if signed).
Caller-info attributes are compile-time literals in IL, not a stack walk.
Reflection that invents types at run time fights Native AOT and trimming; generators move that work to compile time.
Treat PublicAPI.Shipped.txt like a contract: CI should fail when a public member appears without an approved diff.
bullets: An assembly is IL + metadata the loader binds — not an ES module graph (module 01).
Friend access does not transitively leak to AssemblyC because it referenced AssemblyB.
Obsolete and Experimental are compiler-interpreted; your custom attributes are data until something reads them.
GetCustomAttributes instantiates a new attribute object each call — do not treat it as a singleton.
Public API analyzers are how a shared worker library stops accidental surface growth.
